title: Bulk modifications in C6-2A Districts
previewText: Within the South Street Seaport Subdistrict, for any zoning lot located in a C6-2A District, the underlying height and setback regulations shall apply, except that no minimum base height shall apply, and the depth of a required setback along a narrow street shall be at least 10 feet.
